calls.statement:
SELECT CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) d, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT web_order_id) dist
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE order_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-24' AND order_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2025-12-03'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT 'stg' src, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT web_order_id) d, sum(CASE WHEN web_order_id IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) in_fact
FROM stg_web_order_load WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE)=DATE '2025-11-28'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'sales_lines_orders', count(*), count(DISTINCT receipt_id), sum(CASE WHEN receipt_id IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE channel_code='WB' AND CAST(sale_ts_utc AS DATE)=DATE '2025-11-28'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'sales_lines_saledate', count(*), count(DISTINCT receipt_id), 0
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE channel_code='WB' AND sale_date=DATE '2025-11-28'

calls.statement:
WITH lines AS (
 SELECT receipt_id, min(sale_ts_utc) ts, min(sale_date) sd FROM fact_sales_line WHERE channel_id IN (2,3) GROUP BY 1)
SELECT
 (SELECT count(*) FROM lines WHERE CAST(ts AS DATE)=DATE '2025-11-28') lines_utc_day,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM lines WHERE sd=DATE '2025-11-28') lines_saledate,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_web_order o WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE)=DATE '2025-11-28') orders_utc,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_web_order o WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE)=DATE '2025-11-28' AND web_order_id NOT IN (SELECT receipt_id FROM lines)) orders_no_lines,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM lines WHERE CAST(ts AS DATE)=DATE '2025-11-28' AND receipt_id NOT IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order)) lines_no_order,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_web_order WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE)=DATE '2025-11-28' AND status='cancelled') cancelled
calls.output_preview:
lines_utc_day | lines_saledate | orders_utc | orders_no_lines | lines_no_order | cancelled
357 | 402 | 377 | 20 | 0 | 20
(1 row)

calls.statement:
SELECT date_diff('minute', o.order_ts_utc, l.ts) diff_min, count(*) n
FROM fact_web_order o JOIN (SELECT receipt_id, min(sale_ts_utc) ts FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1) l ON l.receipt_id=o.web_order_id
WHERE CAST(o.order_ts_utc AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-26' AND DATE '2025-11-30'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT count(*) n, count(DISTINCT web_order_id) d, sum(CASE WHEN status='cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) canc,
 sum(CASE WHEN order_total_gross < 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) tiny
FROM fact_web_order WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE)=DATE '2025-11-28' AND (line_count IS NULL OR line_count<=0)
